setupNote: Create the first administrator with a password of at least 8 characters.

saleHelp: Each completed sale belongs to the selected legal company and uses its stock. Completed records cannot be edited or deleted.

workerHelp: The new worker is assigned to the active company. Use a password of at least 8 characters.

salesHelp: Permanent sales history. Amounts in BND. Workers see only their company’s sales.
errWorkerCompany: Workers can only manage their assigned company.
errQtyReason: Positive quantity and reason are required.
errPassword: Username and a password of at least 8 characters are required.
errSetup: A private setup token is required.
errPromoType: Promotion type and both language titles are required.
errDates: The end date must be after the start date.
errDiscount: The discount price must be below the original price.
errExistingUser: That username is already in use.
manualPayment: Payment arrangements will be confirmed by the shop. No online payment is taken.
confirmDelete: Delete this product? Sales history will remain.
previewOrders: Online ordering is temporarily unavailable. Please contact the shop.
errRequest: Check the supplied fields and available stock.
errRate: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
recoveryHelp: The owner must set ADMIN_RECOVERY_TOKEN in this shop’s Railway variables and deploy it first. Use a new random token of at least 32 characters. Enter the existing administrator username, a new password and that token. Each token works once. Remove it from Railway after recovery. Workers must ask their administrator to reset their password.
loginHelp: Use the password assigned to this account, not the setup token. Usernames ignore letter case and surrounding spaces; passwords must match exactly. Too many attempts require a 10-minute wait.

accountRequired: Sign in or create an account before checkout.
customerPasswordHelp: Use at least 8 characters. Accounts and orders belong only to this shop.

errCustomerLogin: Please sign in to your customer account.
errRecovery: Recovery is unavailable or the token is incorrect or already used. Ask the owner to configure a new recovery token.
workerPasswordHelp: Stored passwords cannot be viewed. Select an account below to set a new password, then sign in at /staff using that username and the new password. Use a separate browser or sign out first to test the worker login.
workerCreatedDetails: Worker saved: {name} · {shop}. Use this username and the password you entered to sign in.
workerResetDetails: Password saved for {name} · {shop}. Previous sessions have been signed out. Sign in using the new password.
workerNameHelp: Save this username and password before continuing. The setup token is not a worker password.

passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.

codHelp: Pay in cash when your order is delivered or collected. No online payment is taken.

catalogueImportInvalid: Please choose the prepared catalogue JSON file.
inventorySearch: Find inventory by name or SKU

invalidMap: Use a valid HTTPS Google Maps shared link.

phoneVerified: Your saved account phone number is verified.

otpRequired: Verify your saved phone number in Account → Personal details before ordering. Use the same number at checkout.
otpFailure: Check your saved Brunei phone number and code. The code may have expired.
otpWait: Too many verification attempts. Please wait and try again.
otpService: Verification service is not available yet. Please try later.

manualConfirmationCustomer: Our staff will contact you by phone or WhatsApp to confirm your order and delivery or collection arrangements.

photoDrop: Drag and drop photos here, or click to choose
confirmRemovePhoto: Remove this product photo? You can upload it again from your original file.
categoryManagerHelp: Search inventory above, then select a product and save its category. This changes only the category, keeping stock and prices unchanged.
autoCategoryHelp: Administrator: preview name-based categories for uncategorised products. Existing categories are preserved. Unclear items stay uncategorised for review.
categoryPreviewSummary: {count} products can be grouped; {remaining} need manual review.

logoHelp: Administrator only. Upload the company logo as JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. It appears in the website header and footer.
